answer: Audits are recorded in oasis, queued in glacier, and hollow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 89 identities per epoch. A farm of 311 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3680 identities would post 3259 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
